outcome: Newborn leukocyte telomere length (LTL) at birth
cohort: The study included 112 healthy women recruited in early pregnancy and their newborns.
finding: A higher mean maternal TNF-a/IL-10 ratio across pregnancy was significantly associated with shorter newborn leukocyte telomere length, with newborn TL being, on average, 10% shorter in offspring of women in the upper compared to lower quartile of the ratio.
